description: Engine parity (plans/cmux-next/chrome-parity/p15-oracle.md 3F.4, task p15-oracle-113): `oracle.py diff --engine webkit,chromium` compares the two browser.defaultEngine arms of one build. `projected` values name the engine, not a behavior, and are rewritten on both arms before diff.py. `expected_differences` are the values where the arms differ by design, each with its reason (diff.py --expected); every other divergence is a parity bug.

projected.reason: each arm's own engine name (webkit, or chromium/cef): parity asks whether the tabs behave the same without it

a tab opened without a URL loads its engine's New Tab page, chrome://newtab/ in Chromium and about:blank in WebKit (BrowserNewTabPage.initialURL); both are the New Tab page (BrowserNewTabPage.isNewTabPage)

expected_differences.reason: the effective config holds browser.defaultEngine, the one setting the arms differ in
browser.defaultEngine is a non-default key on the webkit arm only: chromium is the default (BrowserDefaultEngine.fallback)
browser tabs and cmux pages follow browser.defaultEngine, so the webkit arm hosts them in WebKit views instead of CEF browsers
